title: Berner Middle School had 57 multiracial students in 2025-26
text:
Berner Middle School enrolled 57 multiracial students in the 2025-26 school year, marking a 7.5% increase from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
Data indicated that the school’s total enrollment for 2025-26 reached 1,487 students. Multiracial students represented 3.8% of the population, making them the third largest ethnic group at the school.
Located within the Massapequa Union Free School District, Berner Middle School is administered from an office in Massapequa.
Of the district’s nine schools, Berner Middle School reported the highest number of multiracial students at that time.
World Population Review analysis shows that New York’s public education system ranked second in the U.S. overall and 31st for K-12 performance.
